description: Search Statbel (Be.STAT) statistical views by words in their title. Returns view ids for statbel_get_view. Titles are in the view's own language: search in English, French or Dutch.

language.description: Only return views published in this language

limit.description: Maximum number of views to return

query.description: Words that must all appear in the title, e.g. 'population region' or 'prix logement'

name: statbel_search_datasets
